body: Fixed 4 critical issues: (1) signalapi poll interval 2s→30s, eliminating 73% CPU burn from constant NDJSON scan; (2) stub-backfill command re-analyzes 1563 cached source docs with haiku without re-fetching EDGAR; (3) signal_failed TTL 30d lets 429-rate-limited filings retry; (4) 4MB doc truncation→extract first 4MB of clean text instead of failing — preserves big 10-K analysis.
title: System health fixes: signalapi CPU, stub backfill, 429 retry TTL, 4MB doc truncation
